nphi.title: GHPP Egypt – GMP training for the Egyptian Drug Authority
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA); Biotech Training Facility (Leiden)
nphi.summary: Basic and advanced Good Manufacturing Practice training for EDA staff: quality systems, risk management, deviations and CAPA, data integrity and inspection preparedness.

nphi.title: National Inventory of Dangerous Pathogens in North Africa
nphi.with: CRDF Global (US State Dept ISN/CTR funding)
nphi.summary: As a CRDF Global subcontractor, RIVM adapted its Uganda pathogen-inventory software and method, then held consultations with Jordan and Tunisia.

nphi.title: VaccTrain Next – Regulatory oversight of clinical trials of vaccines and biologicals
nphi.with: Food and Drugs Authority (Ghana); Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; National Drug Authority (Uganda); Pharmacy and Poisons Board (Kenya); Botswana Medicines Regulatory Authority; Rwanda Food and Drugs Authority; Egyptian Drug Authority; AUDA-NEPAD (AVAREF, AU-3S); WHO AFRO; CEPI (Norway)
nphi.summary: Strengthens African regulators' scientific and regulatory capacity to oversee clinical trials of vaccines and biologicals, including for emergency settings.

nphi.title: VaccRelease 2.0 – Official lot release of vaccines and other biologicals
nphi.with: Food and Drugs Authority Ghana; Rwanda Food and Drugs Authority; South African National Control Laboratory for Biological Products; Egyptian Drug Authority; AUDA-NEPAD / African Medicines Quality Forum
nphi.summary: Builds regulatory and laboratory capacity in African countries for independent official lot release of vaccines and biologicals, supporting local manufacturing.

nphi.title: PharmTrain3 – Regulatory capacities for marketing authorisation of medicinal products
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: AUDA-NEPAD; Egyptian Drug Authority; Food and Drugs Authority (Ghana); Rwanda Food and Drugs Authority; Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; NAFDAC (Nigeria); National Drug Authority (Uganda); Pharmacy and Poisons Board (Kenya); SADC-MRH Secretariat; SAHPRA (South Africa); TMDA (Tanzania); WHO; Paul-Ehrlich-Institut (Germany)
nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer strengthening of African medicines regulators in assessing marketing authorisation applications, focusing on clinical assessment and biologicals/biosimilars.

nphi.title: Africa CDC North Africa Regional Coordinating Centre (Cairo)
nphi.with: Egypt Ministry of Health and Population (host); Tunisia (presidency)
nphi.summary: The North Africa RCC is hosted by Egypt; in June 2025 its steering committee in Cairo approved Tunisia to preside over it.

nphi.title: Africa CDC regional biomanufacturing capacity-building centre, Egypt with Morocco
nphi.with: Egyptian Vaccine Manufacturers Alliance / Unified Procurement Authority
nphi.summary: Egypt, in partnership with Morocco, was chosen to host a regional centre for capacity building in biomanufacturing, supported by Africa CDC.

nphi.title: China–Egypt collaborative research on schistosomiasis and other vector-borne tropical diseases
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Theodor Bilharz Research Institute; Ain Shams University; Ministry of Health and Population Egypt; Academy of Scientific Research and Technology
nphi.summary: NSFC-funded joint research project; an August 2024 China CDC delegation visit held a progress meeting and discussed schistosomiasis and malaria control, research and training, aiming at a longer-term China–Africa tropical disease…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 110 – One Health Secure
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); CSIC; IRD; IZS Teramo; AVIA-GIS
nphi.summary: EU CBRN Centres of Excellence project in which Institut Pasteur and Italy's ISS, with veterinary and research partners, help Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel countries prepare for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases through One…

nphi.title: NAMRU-EURAFCENT – Tunisia joint health cooperation programme
nphi.actor: US Naval Medical Research Unit EURAFCENT (NAMRU-EURAFCENT)
nphi.with: Tunisian Ministry of Health; NAMRU-EURAFCENT Cairo detachment
nphi.summary: Programme launched in 2022 and reaffirmed in February 2025 supporting genomic surveillance of respiratory and febrile illnesses, vector surveillance and vector-borne disease research, and laboratory capacity in Tunisia.

nphi.title: Egypt Field Epidemiology Training Program
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Population (MOH) Egypt
nphi.summary: CDC helped establish Egypt's FETP in 1993, the second-oldest in the Middle East and North Africa, and continues to support its three tiers, which have produced over 400 graduates.

nphi.title: Institution-Based Network on China–Africa Cooperation for Schistosomiasis Elimination
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: University of Yaoundé; Theodor Bilharz Research Institute (Egypt); African schistosomiasis programmes
nphi.summary: Network of Chinese and African institutions working on schistosomiasis elimination, hosted by NIPD. Its 7th annual meeting was held in Haikou in 2022.

nphi.title: SAPHIR – public health intelligence training and EIOS noise-reduction pilots
nphi.with: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; WHO EMRO
nphi.summary: RKI and the WHO Hub train pilot countries in public health intelligence and develop AI-based noise reduction for the EIOS platform.

nphi.title: Egypt–Texas public health laboratory twinning
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Population Egypt; Central Public Health Laboratory (CPHL, National Influenza Center); Texas public health laboratory
nphi.summary: CDC supports a laboratory twinning between Egypt's public health laboratory system and the Texas state public health laboratory to exchange information and strengthen genomics skills for respiratory diseases.

nphi.title: Africa CDC peer-to-peer and twinning programme between North African NPHIs
nphi.with: National public health institutes of North African AU member states
nphi.summary: Africa CDC programme, financed by the World Bank Africa CDC Support Program (P178633), to establish and strengthen NPHIs in North Africa, including support for peer-to-peer learning and twinning between NPHIs in the region.

nphi.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC…

nphi.title: GOARN in the Eastern Mediterranean: partner institutions and 2019-2020 deployments
nphi.actor: GOARN Eastern Mediterranean partner institutions (incl. NIH Pakistan, Institut Pasteur Tunis, EMPHNET)
nphi.with: National Institute of Health Pakistan; Institut Pasteur du Maroc; Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Institut Pasteur of Iran; EMPHNET; Ministries of Health
nphi.summary: 17 partner institutions from 12 countries support outbreak deployments, e.g. 25 experts to the Larkana HIV outbreak in Pakistan, cholera in Yemen, floods in Iran and measles in Tunisia (2019-2020).

nphi.title: ICMR/AU-STRC Health Practitioners and Researchers Capacity Building Scheme
nphi.with: African Union Scientific, Technical and Research Commission (AU-STRC); ICMR-National Institute of Cancer Prevention and Research (NICPR), Noida
nphi.summary: Under the ICMR–African Union MoU, ICMR set up a capacity-building scheme for African health researchers. Its first course, on molecular biology techniques for cancer research, trained 11 researchers from nine African countries at…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 075 – MediLabSecure (One Health biological risks in the Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel)
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); IRD; INIA; IZS Teramo; Avia-GIS
nphi.summary: EU-funded network led by Institut Pasteur with Italy's ISS that strengthened laboratories and public health institutions in 22 neighbouring countries to detect and respond to arboviruses and their vectors, including external quality…

nphi.title: PREPARE – Partnership for Building Resilience against Public Health Emergencies through Advanced Research and Education
nphi.with: INRB (DRC), ZNPHI (Zambia), NMIMR (Ghana), KEMRI (Kenya), Suez Canal University (Egypt) and other core laboratories
nphi.summary: JICA programme linking core infectious disease laboratories in Africa and Asia, including JICA-funded BSL-3 facilities at DRC's INRB, regional surveillance training at ZNPHI and long-term training run with Nagasaki and Hokkaido…

nphi.title: MediPIET – Mediterranean and Black Sea Programme for Intervention Epidemiology Training
nphi.with: FIIAPP; FCSAI; ECDC (scientific lead); national public health authorities of partner countries
nphi.summary: An EU-initiated field epidemiology fellowship for Mediterranean and Black Sea countries. ISCIII co-implemented it with FIIAPP (2014–2017) and FCSAI (2018–2021); ECDC ran it alone from 2021 to 2025.

nphi.title: International Emerging Infections Program (IEIP) sites
nphi.with: icddr,b (Bangladesh); Egyptian MoHP and NAMRU-3; GDD Regional Centre partners in China, Guatemala, Kenya and Thailand
nphi.summary: CDC's International Emerging Infections Program ran population-based surveillance and research on emerging infections at six sites, mostly within the GDD Regional Centers, with a Bangladesh site formalised with icddr,b in 2009.

nphi.title: International Emerging Infections Program (IEIP) Egypt
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Population (MoHP) Egypt; Central Public Health Laboratories
nphi.summary: CDC–MoHP programme established in 2005 in Damanhur to strengthen disease surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, data management and training, intended as a model for expansion across the Nile Delta and to support Egypt's role as an Africa…

nphi.title: Global Disease Detection (GDD) Regional Centers network
nphi.with: Host ministries of health / national public health institutes (not named on source page)
nphi.summary: CDC set up ten GDD Regional Centers between 2004 and 2013, working with host governments on outbreak detection and response, laboratory capacity, field epidemiology training and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: NOSOMED – Strengthening healthcare epidemiology and investigation of nosocomial infections in the Mediterranean
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Algeria; CHU Farhat Hached (Tunisia); General Organisation of Teaching Hospitals and Institutes (Egypt); Université Hassan II (Morocco); University of Turin
nphi.summary: EU FP5 international cooperation project building hospital-infection epidemiology capacity in North Africa and Egypt, with Algeria's national public health institute as a partner.
